description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [100% Critical (25s)] to all allies, grants [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Sazh (Machinist)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Sazh (Machinist)
description.text: Cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Machinist abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Sazh (Machinist) after using two Machinist abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Chocolina Blues+
description.text: Grants [10% Damage Reduction Barrier 1], grants [Exertion ATK and MAG +5%/10%/20%/30%], grants [Exertion 1/2/3/3] to the user if the user has Exertion 0/1/2/3

description.name: Godsend Shot+
description.text: Three single ranged attacks (1.10/1.15 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, grants [Buff Fire 10% (15s)], [Buff Ice 10% (15s)] and [Buff Lightning 10% (15s)] to all allies every third activation

description.name: Spirit Attack: Sazh (Machinist)
description.text: Grants [Deadly Strikes +10% 1]/[Deadly Strikes +30% 1] if 0-3/4+ allies are Machinists

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
